name: Primary Bone Dysplasia with Disorganized Development of Skeletal Components

criteria.description: Presence of disorganized and irregular bone formation on radiographic imaging
Clinical evidence of multiple skeletal malformations including limb deformities and abnormal bone shape
Exclusion of secondary causes of bone dysplasia such as metabolic or acquired disorders
Identification of causative genetic mutations if available

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of major radiologic abnormalities and clinical skeletal malformations with exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory due to limited known mutations.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Disorganized bone architecture with irregular ossification centers
searchTerms: disorganized bone structure with irregular ossification

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital limb deformities with abnormal bone shape
searchTerms: birth defects causing abnormal limb bones

common.symptomName: Short stature due to impaired skeletal growth
searchTerms: short height due to poor bone growth
short stature caused by impaired bone development

common.symptomName: Joint contractures and limited range of motion
Skeletal pain related to abnormal bone structure
Delayed motor milestones secondary to skeletal abnormalities

occasional.symptomName: Spinal deformities including scoliosis or kyphosis
Fractures with minimal trauma due to bone fragility
Facial dysmorphism related to craniofacial bone involvement
Mild developmental delay secondary to physical disability

rare.symptomName: Respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage deformities
searchTerms: respiratory issues due to thoracic cage shape
lung compromise from chest wall abnormalities

rare.symptomName: Hearing impairment related to ossicular malformations
searchTerms: hearing loss from ear bone problems
hearing impairment due to ear bones

rare.symptomName: Neuropathic pain due to nerve compression from bone abnormalities
searchTerms: tingling due to bone pressing nerves

laboratory: Normal metabolic bone markers (calcium, phosphate, alkaline phosphatase)
Exclusion of metabolic bone disease markers
imaging: Radiographs showing irregular ossification centers and disorganized bone pattern
CT/MRI demonstrating abnormal bone morphology and skeletal deformities
genetic: Possible mutations in genes regulating bone development (if identified)
Negative for mutations associated with other known skeletal dysplasias
other: Histopathology showing disorganized bone matrix and abnormal osteoid formation

distinguishingFeatures: Normal bone architecture but shortened bones

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress due to thoracic cage deformity
Progressive neurological deficits from spinal deformities
Multiple pathological fractures indicating severe bone fragility
references: Orphanet: Primary Bone Dysplasia with Disorganized Development of Skeletal Components, ORPHA:93450
